sentences.en: It is courageous of you to say such a thing.
sentences.zh: 你这么说真是勇气可嘉。

sentences.en: I think that he's the world's most courageous fire fighter.
sentences.zh: 我认为他是世界上最勇敢的消防员。

sentences.en: He isn't going to be courageous enough to do that.
sentences.zh: 他不够勇敢去做那件事。

senses.zh: 勇敢的，无畏的,有胆量的,英勇的,勐
